scope: Chromium/Firefox credential detection audit and human autofill follow-up; generated synthetic HTTPS credentials and disposable profiles only
limitations: The public Google identifier markup was inspected through anonymous HTTPS GET only; its JavaScript, password step and real authentication were not tested.
Qualified input was simulated by the unshipped native test driver; the actual native popup was checked without physical account-picker clicks.
Automatic Save/Update capture for username-first and formless JavaScript flows remains unsupported.
The installed running browser was not replaced or stopped.
runnerNotes: The restricted runner denied Node's test worker spawn with EPERM. The in-process focused test passed, and the ordinary-user full build passed all normal test commands. No product security boundary was relaxed.
